order_note: No predecessor: SQL 133 calls none of SQL 130, 131 or 132's functions; it follows them by the order of work the owner set (2026-10-30 'ok build the reset after SQL 131 and the lockout fix'). SQL 133 creates one new function, financial_totp_admin_reset_enrollment(uuid, uuid), on the financial TOTP enrollment schema created on the AWS databases from aws/migrations/proposed/NOT_APPLIED_20260911_financial_totp_enrollment.sql (on no release key) and the tenant membership and identity tables. The spec prerequisites are financial_totp_enrollments (application_user_id), tenant_users (tenant_id, user_id), identity_accounts (application_user_id, email), profiles (id, email), auth.uid() and role checksops; a read-only production inspect confirms them. The applying login must be able to reach all four relations as the function's owner past RLS (definer_can_write_relations on each: the table owner without FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, or a superuser or BYPASSRLS): the function deletes from financial_totp_enrollments and reads the other three for its gate, and a gate filtered by RLS would refuse every reset or let one through on a partial view. Expected pre-state in both environments: the function absent (release sql133 v1 / function public.financial_totp_admin_reset_enrollment(uuid, uuid): absent). Where it already exists (a re-run) it must be owned by the applying login (functions_owned_by_login), keep its TABLE result (function_results_match) and hold no EXECUTE grant other than checksops and the owner, which the file keeps, and PUBLIC, which it revokes (function_acl_replaceable). The ACL after the apply is checksops and the owner. The API change that calls the function (aws/functions/api/admin-reset-totp.mjs, this change) tolerates its absence (the Cognito and profiles reset as before, financialTotpCleared false, never a 500) and needs the guarded Lambda path after this pin is applied in that environment; no API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin. Adds no trigger.
